双击「启动科研绘图.cmd」后可继续。当前草稿仍保存在本机。: Run start.cmd to continue. Your current draft remains on this computer.

把数据列对应到图形: Map data columns to the chart
这些设置会重新计算图形，结果会自动同步。: These settings recalculate the figure and update the result automatically.
选择分组与测量列，整理后的数据会进入同一张图。: Choose group and value columns. Prepared data feeds the same figure.

例如：第一列是基因，每个样本各占一列。整理后得到“行名称、列名称、数值”。: For example, one gene column and one column per sample become row, column and value fields.

导出基于点击时的完整数据与参数，不会把预览截图当成结果。: Exports use the full data and settings at the moment you click, rendered by R.
包含原始数据、整理后的数据、图形参数、R 程序和运行版本信息。: Includes source data, prepared data, figure settings, R code and runtime versions.

只应用样式，不覆盖你的数据和标题: Apply styling while preserving data and titles
已恢复为草稿，保存后会建立新版本。: Restored as a draft. Saving will create a new version.
保存配色和外观，不包含实验数据、标题与分析结论。: Save colors and appearance without experimental data, titles or analysis results.
让你正在使用的智能体读取实验背景、选择图形和整理表格，再在这里继续细调。: Let your agent read the experimental context, choose a chart and prepare the table. Continue fine-tuning here.
已经有明确图形：告诉智能体图名，让它整理所需列。: Know the chart you want? Tell your agent its name and have it prepare the required columns.
不确定画什么：让智能体先确认实验单位、分组和配对关系，再推荐图形。: Not sure? Ask your agent to check experimental units, groups and pairing before recommending charts.
项目附带独立的“科研绘图”Skill 与命令接口。智能体输出的项目文件可从“我的: The project includes a standalone cevris-plot Skill and a command interface. Open agent-prepared project files in My projects.
网页本身不发送数据给外部模型。智能体调用使用你自己的账户，遵循你所用智能体的数据: This web app does not send data to external models. Agent usage is billed to your own account and follows that agent's data settings.
在图表库选择一种图，打开示例并下载数据格式。: Choose a chart in the library, open its example and download the example data.
选择文件和工作表，指定每列的含义。缺失值会提示，不会静默丢弃。: Select a file and worksheet, then map column meanings. Missing values are reported, never silently dropped.
滑块、颜色与标题会触发实际 R 绘图。保存样式后可用于另一批数据。: Sliders, colors and titles trigger real R rendering. Saved styles can be applied to another dataset.
项目文件可以再次编辑；矢量图用于排版，复现包保留数据与绘图程序。: Project files remain editable; vector images support publication layouts. Bundles preserve data and rendering code.
双击项目文件夹中的「启动科研绘图.cmd」，会先启动本地绘图服务，再打开网页。仅: Run start.cmd in the project folder to start the local service and open the page. Opening the URL alone does not start the service.
首次安装需要网络。安装完成后，手动导入、编辑、保存和导出可在本地运行。: Installation needs internet access. Once installed, manual import, editing, saving and export work locally.
留空继承全局设置。: Leave blank to inherit the global setting.
留空为自动；只调整显示范围。: Leave blank for automatic limits. Only the display range changes.
当前使用模拟数据，不可作为真实实验结果: Synthetic demo data; not real experimental results
绘图尺度，不是磅；统一控制轴线与描边。: ggplot units, not points; axes inherit this unless overridden.
按你的分析方案填写，示例值不是通用标准。: Use your analysis plan; the demo threshold is not a universal standard.
无法连接本地绘图服务。请双击「启动科研绘图.cmd」后重试。: Cannot connect to the local service. Run start.cmd and retry.
处理时间较长，请稍后重试。当前草稿仍保存在本机。: The operation timed out. Retry; your local draft is preserved.
本地服务暂时不可用，请重新启动科研绘图。: Local service unavailable; restart the application.
数值列不能重复选择: Numeric columns cannot be selected twice
行包含非数值，请检查所选测量列: rows contain nonnumeric values; check the measurement columns
行缺失值，原始数据仍保留: missing rows; source observations are preserved
行缺失值；请补全或明确勾选“排除缺失行”: rows contain missing values; complete them or explicitly enable exclusion
至少需要两条有效观测: At least two valid observations are required
分组超过60个，请筛选后绘图: More than 60 groups; filter the data first
密度估计每组至少需要3条有效观测，可改用分组散点图: Density estimation needs at least three observations per group; consider a dot plot
所有测量相同，无法估计密度: All measurements are identical; density cannot be estimated
同一个体在同一条件下有多条记录，请先整理技术重复: Repeated records for the same subject and condition; resolve technical replicates
每组存在重复横坐标，请先汇总后绘制折线: Duplicate X values within a group; summarize them before drawing lines
同一行列组合有重复记录，请先汇总: Repeated matrix cells; summarize them first
显著性必须大于0且不超过1；零值请回到分析结果确认精度: P values must be greater than zero and at most one; check precision for reported zeros
百分比图每组总量必须大于0: Every percentage group needs a positive total
对数横轴需要大于0的平均表达量: Log X requires strictly positive mean expression
富集比例应在0到1之间，命中数应大于0: Enrichment ratios must be in [0,1] and counts positive
估计值必须位于所提供的上下区间内: Estimates must lie within their supplied bounds
矩阵计算至少需要3个完整样本: Matrix calculations require at least three complete observations
数值列含常数列，请取消选择该列: Constant numeric columns cannot be analyzed; deselect them
当前使用原始显著性，阈值未校正多重比较: Raw P values are in use; the threshold does not adjust for multiple comparisons
请选择行名称列和有效数值列: Select an identifier column and valid numeric columns
展开后超过30000行，请减少选中的列: Reshaping exceeds 30000 rows; select fewer columns
检测到时间和事件列；确认一人一行、共同起点、1为事件且0为右删失后，可计算生存曲: Time and event columns detected. Confirm one row per subject, a common time origin, and event=1/censored=0 before estimating survival.
可逐个体查看随访长度与结局；需要唯一的个体编号。: Show individual follow-up lengths and outcomes; unique subject identifiers are required.
检测到分类单元与计数，可比较群落的丰度排序。: Taxon and count fields detected; compare community abundance ranks.
若数据为真实整数个体计数，可计算无放回抽样的期望物种数；不能使用相对丰度。: Integer individual counts support expected richness without replacement. Relative abundance is not suitable.
检测到染色体与起止坐标；请统一基因组版本及0基半开区间约定。: Chromosome and interval fields detected; confirm the genome assembly and zero-based half-open coordinates.
存在日期和数值，可逐日查看观测；同一天只能一条汇总记录，缺测不会自动补零。: Date and value fields detected. Supply one daily summary; missing days will not be filled with zeros.
检测到已有的假阳性率和真阳性率，可展示模型评价曲线。: Supplied false-positive and true-positive rates can be displayed as ROC curves.
检测到已有召回率和精确率，可展示 PR 曲线。: Supplied recall and precision can be displayed as PR curves.
检测到已有随访时间和生存概率；不代替原始生存数据分析。: Supplied time and survival probabilities detected; this does not replace individual-level survival analysis.
检测到染色体和位置列，需要已有显著性结果才能绘制。: Chromosome and position detected; precomputed P values are required.
实验背景涉及测量方法比较，需确认同一样本的两种同单位测量。: Method-comparison context detected. Confirm paired, same-unit measurements on the same subjects.
检测到已有的效应与显著性列，可展示差异结果；需确认显著性类型。: Effect and P-value columns detected. Confirm whether P values are raw or adjusted.
实验描述涉及重复测量，需要个体编号确认配对。: Repeated-measurement context detected; a subject identifier is needed to establish pairing.
存在分组和数值列，先展示原始观测可保留样本信息。: Group and numeric columns detected; plotting individual observations preserves sample information.
可比较各组中位数与四分位范围。: Compare group medians and interquartile ranges.
各组具有一定样本量，可补充分布形状；仍应保留原始点。: Groups have enough observations to show distribution shape; retain raw points.
存在多个数值列，可探索变量之间的关系。: Multiple numeric columns allow exploring relationships between variables.
存在多个数值特征，可探索样本总体差异；需确认量纲。: Multiple numeric features allow exploring overall sample differences; confirm units and scaling.
可先查看单一数值列的分布，需要选择有效测量列。: Inspect a single numeric distribution; select the appropriate measurement column.
离线规则建议，不是大语言模型分析；请结合实验设计选择。: Offline rule-based suggestions, not an LLM analysis. Choose using the experimental design.
使用指定显示范围；范围外的数据仍参与计算: uses explicit display limits; observations outside them still contribute to calculations
以长度或面积编码数值的图形需要保留零基线: Length- and area-encoded charts must retain a zero baseline
对数横轴范围必须大于0: Log X limits must be positive
概率或比率应在0到1之间: Probabilities and ratios must be in [0,1]
假阳性率或召回率应在0到1之间: False-positive rates and recall must be in [0,1]
生存概率不能随时间增加: Survival probability cannot increase over time
ROC 真阳性率不能沿假阳性率增大的方向下降；同一横坐标应按阈值路径排列: ROC sensitivity cannot decrease along increasing false-positive rate; retain threshold order for ties
仅展示已有曲线，不重新拟合或计算模型评价指标: Supplied curves only; no refitting or model-metric calculation
每个系列在同一横坐标只能有一条记录: One record per series and X position is required
每个系列至少需要两个时间点: Each series needs at least two time points
估计值必须位于区间上下界内: Estimate must lie within interval bounds
区间来自输入表，请在图注说明其统计含义: Intervals come from the input table; describe their statistical meaning in the caption
每个条目只能有一条记录，请先汇总: One record per item is required; summarize first
一致性界限至少需要3个独立样本: Agreement limits require at least three independent subjects
样本编号重复；重复测量需使用适当的一致性分析方法: Repeated subject IDs; repeated measurements require an appropriate agreement method
请选择两种不同方法的测量列: Select measurement columns for two different methods
一致性界限按独立差值近似正态且变异稳定计算；不能仅凭图形判定方法可互换: Agreement limits assume independent, approximately normal differences with stable variance; the plot alone cannot establish interchangeability
每组至少需要两条观测才能计算误差线: At least two observations per group are required for error bars
Q–Q 图每组需要至少3条观测且数值不能全部相同: Q-Q plots require at least three nonconstant observations per group
基因组位置应为非负整数: Genomic positions must be nonnegative integers
显著性必须大于0且不超过1: P values must be greater than zero and at most one
表达比例必须在0到1之间，百分数请先除以100: Expression fractions must be in [0,1]; divide percentages by 100 first
同一基因与细胞群只能有一条汇总记录: One summary per gene and cell type is required
密度计算需要每组至少3个非恒定数值: Density needs at least three nonconstant observations per group
蜂群图最多1500个点；大样本建议分组散点或密度图: Beeswarm supports at most 1500 points; consider grouped dots or density
二维密度每组需至少6个观测，两个方向各至少3个不同数值: 2D density requires six observations and three distinct values along each dimension per group
二维分箱的两个方向均需要有变异: Both dimensions need variation for 2D binning
等高线需要至少3×3的完整规则网格，位置不可重复: Contours require a complete regular grid of at least 3 by 3, with no repeated positions
网格每个方向需等距；请先明确完成插值，不自动补点: Grid positions must be equally spaced in each dimension; interpolation must be explicitly completed beforehand
等高线数值不能全部相同: Contour values cannot all be equal
每个系列须提供相同的时间点，每个位置一条记录: Every series must have the same time points with one record per position
同一系列的连接次序不可重复: Sequence positions cannot repeat within a series
排名应为正整数，每个系列时间点唯一: Ranks must be positive integers and time points unique within series
斜率图每个条目一行，并选择两个不同测量列: Slope plots need one row per item and two distinct measurement columns
雷达图需3–12个指标，每组指标一致且每个组合唯一: Radar needs 3-12 traits, consistent across groups, with unique cells
指标需在0和共同尺度上限之间；请先说明标准化方法: Traits must lie between zero and the common maximum; document prior normalization
组成或份额数值须非负且总量大于0: Composition values must be nonnegative with a positive total
每个类别一条正数汇总记录，最多20类: One positive summary per category; at most 20 categories
列联频数应为整数且每个分类组合唯一: Contingency counts must be integers with unique category combinations
桑基图每侧最多15个节点；请减小节点间隙: Sankey supports 15 nodes per side; reduce node gaps
网络图需3–40个节点，最多200条边: Networks require 3-40 nodes and at most 200 edges
当前网络图使用正权重、无自环且不重复的无向边: Networks accept positive, undirected, unique edges without self-loops
校准概率须在0–1内，各组分箱预测值唯一: Calibration probabilities must be in [0,1]; predicted bins must be unique within groups
三元分量不得为负，每行总量须大于0: Ternary components must be nonnegative with a positive row total
分类矩阵的每个样本特征组合需唯一且不超过40000格: Categorical matrix cells must be unique, with at most 40000 cells
交集图需2–8个集合，每个元素与集合的成员关系只记一行: UpSet supports 2-8 sets; each element-set membership is recorded once
主成分计算需至少3个样本，各所选数值列不能恒定: PCA requires at least three observations and nonconstant numeric columns
每组总量必须大于0: Each group must have a positive total
面积、频数或柱形图需保留零基线: Area, count and bar charts must retain zero
河流图使用居中基线，裁切会隐藏部分组成厚度: Streamgraphs use a centered baseline; clipping can hide component thickness
至少3个样本，各数值特征不能全部相同: At least three observations and nonconstant numeric features are required
每个样本编号必须唯一，且只占一行: Each sample ID must be unique with one row per sample
样本编号不可同时用作数值特征: The sample identifier cannot also be a numeric feature
分组列不可同时用作数值特征: The grouping column cannot also be a numeric feature
聚类热图需完整且不重复的2–150行、2–100列矩阵，不自动补齐缺失格: Clustered heatmaps need a complete unique matrix of 2-150 rows and 2-100 columns; missing cells are not imputed
存在恒定特征，无法按行标准化；可改用原始数值: Constant features cannot be row-standardized; use original values
每个独立个体只能一行；当前不支持重复随访行或延迟入组: One row per independent subject; repeated follow-up records and delayed entry are unsupported
随访时间必须大于0，单位保持一致: Follow-up times must be positive and in consistent units
事件状态必须明确编码为1（事件）或0（右删失）: Encode event status as 1 (event) or 0 (right censored)
最多比较8个随访组: At most eight follow-up groups are supported
泳道图最多60个个体，请先明确筛选范围: Swimmer plots support at most 60 subjects; filter explicitly
没有观察到事件，生存曲线将保持为1；无法据此推断无风险: No events were observed; survival remains one, which does not establish zero risk
随访时间显示范围不能为负: Follow-up display limits cannot be negative
每个区间的终点必须大于起点: Every interval must end after it starts
甘特图任务名必须唯一，最多60项: Gantt task names must be unique; at most 60 tasks
基因组坐标须为非负安全整数，采用0基半开区间: Genomic coordinates must be nonnegative safe integers using zero-based half-open intervals
区间轨道最多12条染色体、300个区间: Tracks support at most 12 chromosomes and 300 intervals
日期必须是有效的YYYY-MM-DD字符串，例如2026-03-18: Dates must be valid YYYY-MM-DD strings, e.g. 2026-03-18
日历图跨度最多两年: Calendar span cannot exceed two years
同一天只能一条记录；请先明确每日汇总方式: One record per date; define the daily aggregation first
角度必须在0–360度内，不能混用弧度: Angles must be in [0,360] degrees; do not mix radians
丰度必须是真实非负整数计数，不能使用相对丰度或标准化值: Abundances must be real nonnegative integer counts, not relative or normalized values
每个样本和分类单元组合只记录一次: Each sample-taxon pair must be recorded once
最多12个群落、10000条计数记录: At most 12 communities and 10000 count records
每个群落总计数须大于0且不超过10亿: Each community total must be positive and no greater than one billion
丰度或物种数的显示范围须非负且上限大于0: Abundance/richness display limits must be nonnegative with a positive upper bound
对数丰度轴的最小值须大于0或留空自动: The minimum on a log abundance axis must be positive or left automatic
每条完整路径的数量须大于0: Every complete path must have a positive count
每阶段最多10种状态、最多150条路径；请减小间隙或汇总路径: At most 10 states per stage and 150 paths; reduce gaps or summarize paths
弦图需3–16个节点，最多80条边: Chord diagrams require 3-16 nodes and at most 80 edges
弦图使用正权重、无自环且不重复的无向关系: Chords accept positive, undirected, unique edges without self-loops
比例网格需每类一条正数汇总记录，最多15类: Waffles need one positive summary per category, at most 15 categories
每条目一条记录且名称唯一，最多60条: One record per unique item, at most 60 items
请避免将步骤命名为起始量或最终总量，这两个名称用于总量柱: Do not name steps Initial or Final total; these labels are reserved for endpoint bars
条形或累计量图必须保留零基线: Bar and cumulative charts must retain a zero baseline
每个独立配对仅一行，并选择两个不同条件列: One row per independent pair and two distinct condition columns
二维分箱的两个方向都需要有变异: Both dimensions need variation for 2D binning
云展示分布，箱线展示中位数与四分位区间，雨点保留每条原始观测。: The cloud shows the distribution, the box shows the median and quartiles, and the rain preserves every observation.
只移动组件，不改变测量数值。: Moves components without changing measurement values.
仅沿分组方向散开；测量值不抖动。: Spreads points only along the group direction; measurement values never jitter.
至少保留密度云、箱线或散点中的一个图层: Keep at least one density, box or observation layer visible.
分组云雨图最多支持12个分面，请筛选实验条件: Grouped raincloud supports up to 12 panels. Filter experimental conditions.
密度云每个分组组合至少需要3条观测；可关闭密度云保留箱线和散点: Each group combination needs at least three observations for density. Turn off the cloud to retain boxes and points.
某个分组组合的数值完全相同，无法估计密度；可关闭密度云保留箱线和散点: One group combination is constant, so density cannot be estimated. Turn off the cloud to retain boxes and points.
某个分组的测量值完全相同，无法估计密度，可改用箱线图或散点图: One group is constant, so density cannot be estimated. Use a box or scatter plot.
部分组少于10条观测，密度云对平滑程度较敏感，请同时查看原始散点: Some groups have fewer than 10 observations. Density is sensitive to smoothing; inspect the raw points.
各组有足够的变化观测，可用云雨图同时展示分布、箱线摘要和原始散点。: Groups contain sufficient varying observations for a raincloud showing density, box summaries and raw points.
示例列名仅作参考，导入后可以对应自己的列名。: Example column names are a guide. You can map your own names after import.
每次请选择一个数据文件: Choose one data file at a time
选择或拖入数据文件: Choose or drop a data file
第一行是唯一列名，不要添加标题行或合并单元格。: Use unique column names in the first row. Avoid title rows and merged cells.
测量列只填数值，单位放在列名中；缺失值留空。: Use numbers in measurement columns; put units in column names. Leave missing cells empty.
Excel 公式需先计算并保存，建议粘贴为数值。: Recalculate and save Excel formulas first; pasting values is recommended.
TXT 使用逗号、制表符或分号分隔；不支持图片、PDF 和旧版 XLS。: Separate TXT fields with commas, tabs or semicolons. Images, PDF and legacy XLS are not supported.
显示前50行，绘图使用全部数据: Showing the first 50 rows. Figures use all data.
矢量格式，适合排版和继续编辑图形元素。: Vector format for page layout and further editing of figure elements.
位图格式，按下方尺寸和分辨率生成。: Raster image at the dimensions and resolution below.
请使用 CSV、TSV、TXT 或 XLSX 文件；旧版 XLS 请先另存为 X: Use CSV, TSV, TXT or XLSX. Save legacy XLS as XLSX first.
文件为空，请选择包含数据的文件: The file is empty. Choose a file containing data.
请选择不超过10MB的数据文件: Choose a data file no larger than 10 MB
表格至少需要一行列名和一行数据: Include a header row and at least one data row
表格最多30000行数据、100列，请拆分后导入: The limit is 30,000 data rows and 100 columns. Split the table before importing.
表头存在空列名，请填写第一行的每个列名: A column name is empty. Fill in every name in the first row.
列名最多100个字符，请缩短表头: Column names must be 100 characters or fewer
表头有重复列名，请重命名后导入: Column names are duplicated. Rename them before importing.
无法读取此 XLSX，请在表格软件中另存为标准 XLSX 后重试: Cannot read this XLSX. Save it as a standard XLSX in your spreadsheet app and retry.
找不到所选工作表: The selected worksheet was not found
工作表最多30000行、100列: Worksheets may contain up to 30,000 data rows and 100 columns
工作表含合并单元格，请取消合并并逐行填写后导入: This worksheet has merged cells. Unmerge them and fill each row before importing.
公式没有缓存计算结果，请在表格软件中重新计算并保存，或粘贴为数值后导入: A formula has no cached result. Recalculate and save in your spreadsheet app, or paste values before importing.
表格包含公式错误，请修正错误单元格后导入: The table contains formula errors. Correct them before importing.
文件编码无法识别，请切换为 GB18030，或将文件另存为 UTF-8 后重试: Cannot decode this file. Switch to GB18030, or save the file as UTF-8 and retry.
文本表格格式不一致，请检查每行列数、分隔符和成对引号: Inconsistent text table. Check column counts, delimiters and paired quotes.
正在处理其他项目，请重新导入数据: The project changed. Import the data again.
请上传 CSV、TSV、TXT 或 XLSX；旧版 XLS 请先另存为 XLSX: Use CSV, TSV, TXT or XLSX. Save legacy XLS as XLSX first.
文件超过10MB，请拆分数据后再导入: File exceeds 10 MB. Split the data before importing.
文件为空，请选择包含表头和数据的文件: The file is empty. Include headers and data.
当前项目已变化，请重新确认导入: The project changed. Confirm the import again.
文本单元格最多2000个字符，请缩短长文本后导入: Text cells allow up to 2,000 characters. Shorten long text before importing.
包含实际绘图代码、数据和参数，可在 R / RStudio 独立运行。: Includes actual plotting code, data and settings. Runs independently in R / RStudio.
XLSX 解压后超过64MB或文件条目过多，请另存为CSV或减少工作表后导入: The expanded XLSX exceeds 64 MiB or contains too many entries. Save as CSV or reduce the worksheets.
项目请求超过64MB，请减少数据量或拆分组图: The project request exceeds 64 MiB. Reduce the data or split the composition.
